description: Requires a TechFabric engineer's Microsoft sign-in (scope blog.write). A read: whether one of your drafts may be published now, and if so the question to ask the engineer ("Publish '<title>' now? (yes/no)") with a one-time confirmation for this exact saved text and its checks (used once). Only after they say yes, call publish_draft with the id and that confirmation, and the same override. If it can't be published yet, it says why and what to do.

id.description: The idea id of your own draft

override.description: Publish anyway: the failing check ids the engineer chooses to publish past (only wording and style checks). Send the same list to publish_draft with the confirmation

name: review_before_publishing

confirmation.description: One-time: send it back to publish_draft only after the engineer says yes. Never show it to them

details.description: Where and under whose byline it goes live: show it beside the question if they ask

next_action.description: The one next step. Do what instruction says; call is the tool and the arguments the server already knows

question.description: What to ask the engineer, word for word: "Publish '<title>' now? (yes/no)", then anything else they are agreeing to

reasked.description: True when the confirmation sent no longer fitted (it lapsed, or the text or its checks moved): ask this fresh question instead, plainly

waiting_for.description: card: a client that shows the draft card publishes only on the engineer's Publish there; nothing to send back

title: Review before publishing
